## Standard

<a id="GitHubActions"></a>

### GitHub Actions

`GitHubActions` · `src/github.ts:39`

The words of a workflow file: what starts it, what it may do, its jobs, the machine of a job, its steps (an action used and what it is given, a command run and where), the condition of a step; the expression that names the person who started it.

Source: GitHub Docs, Workflow syntax for GitHub Actions; Contexts reference (github.actor, steps.<id>.outputs); Expressions (always()); actions/upload-artifact v4, outputs (artifact-url) · `https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `name` | The name of the workflow, or of what an action uploads |
| `on` | `on` | What starts the workflow |
| `manual` | `workflow_dispatch` | Started by hand, from GitHub |
| `push` | `push` | Started by a push |
| `branches` | `branches` | The branches a push starts it on |
| `tags` | `tags` | The tags a push starts it on |
| `schedule` | `schedule` | Started at the times a cron expression gives (UTC) |
| `cron` | `cron` | The cron expression of a schedule |
| `permissions` | `permissions` | What the workflow's token may do |
| `contents` | `contents` | The repository's contents |
| `read` | `read` | Read only |
| `jobs` | `jobs` | The jobs of the workflow, by their names |
| `runsOn` | `runs-on` | The machine a job runs on |
| `steps` | `steps` | The steps of a job, in order |
| `uses` | `uses` | The action a step uses |
| `with` | `with` | What the action is given |
| `run` | `run` | The command a step runs |
| `workingDirectory` | `working-directory` | Where the command of a step runs, from the repository's root |
| `when` | `if` | The condition a step runs on |
| `always` | `always()` | Whatever the steps before answered: what keeps the evidence of a shipment refused |
| `nodeVersion` | `node-version` | The version of Node.js setup-node installs |
| `path` | `path` | What upload-artifact keeps, one path a line |
| `retentionDays` | `retention-days` | How many days GitHub keeps what upload-artifact uploaded |
| `id` | `id` | The name of a step, by which a later step reads what it gives |
| `actor` | `${{ github.actor }}` | The person who started the workflow |
| `openExpression` | `"${{ "` | Opens an expression, which GitHub replaces before the step runs |
| `closeExpression` | `" }}"` | Closes it |
| `outputs` | `outputs` | What a step gives, read as steps.<id>.outputs.<name> |
| `dot` | `.` | Between the parts of a context's path |
| `artifactUrl` | `artifact-url` | What upload-artifact (v4) gives: the address of the artefact it uploaded |

## Syntax element

<a id="GitHubWorkflow"></a>

### A workflow of GitHub Actions

`GitHubWorkflow` · `src/github.ts:102` · status: **held**

The workflow that runs a shipment on GitHub: started as its settings say, its token reading the repository only; one job on the machine they name, whose steps check the repository out, install Node.js, install the packages of each directory of the plan, install the generation's own packages when it has its own, run what the packages ask once installed, and ship with the person who started it. Shipped, what the workflow's artefact publishes in the graph is uploaded as an artefact of GitHub (the deployment, on GitHub), kept as many days as the settings say, and its address recorded as evidence of each artefact, attributed to that person; when the settings keep the evidence, it is uploaded as a second artefact, whatever the shipment answered. It publishes and keeps nothing the graph does not name.

Section: Workflow syntax: on, permissions, jobs.<job_id>.runs-on, jobs.<job_id>.steps[*].uses, with, run, working-directory, if · `https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `job` | `ship` | The name of the one job |
| `delivered` | `delivered` | The name of the step that uploads what the shipment ships, whose address is recorded after it |
| `evidence` | `evidence` | After the shipment's name: the name of the artefact that keeps its evidence |
| `joint` | `-` | Between the shipment's name and that word |
| `space` | `" "` | Separates the words of a command |
| `quote` | `"` | Around the person's name, given to the shell as one word |
| `written` | `Written by trame ship from the graph, for the shipment` | What the workflow's first comment says |
| `of` | `of` | Between the shipment and its project, in that comment |
| `edit` | `Do not edit: edit the graph, then ship.` | The comment that says where to change it |

### The actions a workflow uses

`PinnedActions` · `src/github.ts:83`

The actions of GitHub that check the repository out, install Node.js and keep files, each at the major version a workflow names.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| checkout | actions/checkout@v4 |
| setupNode | actions/setup-node@v4 |
| upload | actions/upload-artifact@v4 |
